sentences: You've never heard your real voice.
When you talk, your skull vibrates.
The buzz hits your inner ear directly.
Your skull boosts the low notes!
So in your head, you sound deeper!
A recording only catches the air.
That thin, weird voice you hate?
[laughs] Your friends. Your boss. Your crush!
In a study, people rated voice clips.
Their own voice was secretly mixed in.
and rated it more attractive than other people's!
